name: Komikado Suzuka
source:
The head of the Home Ministry's Internal Security Assurance Bureau's Logistical Support Supervision Department. She is in charge of the logistical support units' supervision as the chief executive. She is a professional logistician who can handle everything from weapon maintenance to household chores. For some reason, the heads of all logistics units are clothed in maid uniforms. There's little doubt that this individual is at fault for the current situation...

Suzuka is a caring individual who exudes affection and maternal feelings. All of the Special Riot Police officers admire her and refer to her as "sister" or "mother." Still, when she's angry, she's terrifying. In the Security Assurance Bureau, she has more influence than [url=https://vndb.org/c108434]Director Gotou[/url].

She has a very glamorous figure. There is a mischievous side in her: having the most huge breast in the story, she forcibly hug the [url=https://vndb.org/c99112]protagonist[/url] or the Special Riot Police girls and embarrass them. Prior to the formation of the Special Riot Police, Suzuka was a colleague of the [url=https://vndb.org/c99112]protagonist[/url]. She had even been his old instructor. At that time, she was thought to be more powerful than the [url=https://vndb.org/c99112]protagonist[/url]. For some reason, she is currently clearly distinct between then and now.

[Translated from the  [url=http://www.propeller-game.com/product/yuzuriha/chara07.html]official site[/url]]
